KEY PRODUCT FEATURES
• Packaging reduced by 45% for less waste
• 100-card ready-to-play Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Commander deck
• Deck includes 2 traditional foils + 98 nonfoil cards
• 1 foil-etched Display Commander
• 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker
• Introduces 15 MTG cards not found in the main set

DESCRIPTION:
The Undead Unleashed Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Commander Deck set includes 1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards (2 traditional foil, 98 nonfoil), 1 foil-etched Display Commander (a thick cardstock copy of the commander card with textured foil etched into the card’s border and art), 10 double-sided tokens, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), 1 life tracker, and 1 reference card—all using 98% less plastic than previous Commander decks, including packaging.
